about: Chat lines with their language, for the conversation window's language detector (addon/TranslateProbe/LangDetect.lua; checked by tests/harness_conv.lua). Synthetic lines written for the tests, no real player's chat. Each entry is [language code, line]; ko, zh and ru are decided by the writing system. "unknown" lists lines in languages the detector has no profile for (Finnish, Dutch, Polish, Swedish): they must come out unknown, never as a wrong language.
